messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 — Elevated 5xx/error rate on /v1/generate for elysium-prod (eu-west-1). P99 latency 3.6s. Paging oncall-jess.

oncall-jess: Acked. Joining. Any impact list for customers in that workspace?

support-ana: Elysium Corp (ACCT: ELY-1234) showing the highest error volume. Also seeing spikes for Aurora Labs (ACCT: AUR-9876) in the same region. Roughly 12% of requests failing with 502/503.

eng-aaron: Looking at model-serving-4 logs now. Seeing frequent `cuda out of memory` OOM traces and retry storms from the autoscaler.

oncall-jess: Steps: 1) Open dedicated pool, 2) scale up instances, 3) enable fallback routing to `gpt-compat-small` model variant, 4) update status page draft. I'll start 1–2 now.

oncall-jess: Running: `redwood infra scale --pool elysium-prod --count +3` — ETA ~2m

status-page-bot: Draft status update created: "Investigating: Elevated error rates affecting generation in EU (eu-west-1). We are working to mitigate impact for affected customers. Next update in 15 minutes."

acctops-mike: @oncall-jess passing to me for targeted customer comms — which contacts should we notify for ELY-1234?

cs-lina: Pushing to existing account contacts: aaron.bishop@elysium.com, ops@elysium.com, and csm-lina@redwood.ai. Prefer short tailored note + expected ETA.

support-ana: Suggested tailored impact for Elysium: "Generation requests (text and chat) in EU region may intermittently fail with 5xx errors. We are mitigating and expect progressive recovery within ~20–30 minutes. No data loss."

oncall-jess: Scale command finished, adding 3 nodes. Also enabling routing-fallback: `routing.update --workspace elysium-prod --route /v1/generate --fallback gpt-compat-small` — switching now.

eng-aaron: Fallback routing applied. New requests are flowing to fallback. Error rate dropping from 12% -> 4% in last 90s. Still monitoring KV cache warm-up impact.

oncall-jess: I'm going to publish a short status page message and send a targeted email to Elysium ops. Drafting now.

status-page-bot: Status page updated to "Monitoring" — mitigation in place; error rate decreasing. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/updates/3141592653

oncall-jess: Proposed customer email (to Elysium ops):

```
Subject: Incident — Intermittent generation errors (EU) — Elysium
Hi Aaron,
We're investigating intermittent 5xx errors impacting generation requests for Elysium in EU (eu-west-1). We've scaled capacity and routed traffic to a fallback model; the error rate is decreasing. Estimated full recovery: 15–30 minutes. No data was lost. We'll post updates on https://status.redwood.ai and follow up when fully resolved.
— Jess (on-call SRE)
```

acctops-mike: Looks good. I'll send that now to the three contacts. Adding AM: sales-rep@redwood.ai in CC.

support-ana: Internal comms snippet for AMs/PL: "Elysium (ELY-1234) experiencing generation errors in EU. Mitigation: scaled pool + fallback routing. Action: monitor; AM to notify customer and set expectation: 15–30 min recovery. Escalate to eng-lead if not resolved in 30 min."

eng-aaron: Error rate now 1.1% and P99 latency back to 850ms. No new OOMs on serving nodes. I'll keep tail logs open for 30m then start rollback of fallback if stable.

oncall-jess: Thanks. I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth. If no regression in 30 minutes, we'll close and send final resolution to Elysium.

status-page-bot: Final update posted: "Resolved — We mitigated elevated error rates in EU; services are operating normally. Post-incident summary will follow."

oncall-jess: Resolved. Final notes: root cause appears to be a spike in request concurrency combined with slower KV cache warming on one model variant causing OOM retries. Follow-up: autoscaler threshold tweak + add pre-warm for hot customers in EU. I'll open a follow-up JIRA.

acctops-mike: Sent resolution email to Elysium and Aurora. Customer replies acknowledged.

cs-lina: Passing to postmortem owner: eng-aaron to draft causal write-up + remediation steps. I'll coordinate customer-facing post-incident summary.

incident-bot: Incident ticket 2026-314159 created, severity=P1, incident owner=oncall-jess, postmortem due in 3 business days.
